title: 5. Maximum Subarray Sum (Kadane's Algorithm)
description: Given an integer array `nums`, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.
constraints:
• 1 <= len(nums) <= 10^5
• -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4
• Optimal Time: O(N) | Optimal Space: O(1)
explanation: Kadane's algorithm decides at each element `x` whether to add `x` to the existing running subarray (`curr_sum + x`) or restart a new subarray from `x` (`max(x, curr_sum + x)`). Tracking the global maximum in a single pass achieves O(N) time and O(1) space.
